options.command: tmp=$(mktemp) && curl --fail --silent --show-error https://reiknivelarapi.rsk.is/swagger/v1/swagger.json -o "$tmp" && jq -e 'if ((.openapi // .swagger) and ((.paths | type) == "object") and ((.paths | length) > 0)) then . else error("RSK did not return an OpenAPI document with paths") end' "$tmp" > /dev/null && mv "$tmp" libs/clients/rsk/calculators/src/clientConfig.json
